# AVIA.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp413.0 against Rp304.0 (expected total return 43.8%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: derated_compounder_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Chemicals, petrochemicals & fertilisers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The only cost mechanism in the model cannot reproduce the history it cites. With 25% of COGS exposed and 95% pass-through, a 16.9% Brent fall (FY2022 98.97 to FY2023 82.19) can add at most about 0.1pp to the gross margin
- The cost of equity does not follow from the inputs the report prints. rf 7.45%, ERP 4.23%, CRP 2.46% and beta 0.90 give 13.47% as rf + beta x (ERP + CRP) or 13.72% as rf + beta x ERP + CRP, not 11.86%. The engine reaches
- The reverse DCF is misread in the sentence that carries the thesis. The engine applies the solved shock to the whole revenue_growth series (fund record _apply_overrides shocks every year of a series input), so -1.76% i

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
